description: After 80 years on the bottom of the Labrador Sea, Terra Nova looks very different than when it carried famed British explorer Robert Falcon Scott to the South Pole. Technology developed by an Ontario company is now mapping the entire ship in three dimensions as part of a Royal Canadian Geographical Society expedition.
title: Over a century after these ships set sail for the South Pole, their wrecks are inspiring new exploration

description: A helicopter company says two people are dead and another is injured after a helicopter crash near north Vancouver Island Tuesday morning.
title: 2 dead, 1 in hospital after helicopter crash near north Vancouver Island

description: California lawmakers, from both sides of the aisle, have signed a letter to Quebec Premier Christine Frechette, urging her to put U.S. wines and spirits back on the shelves, despite Canada's ongoing trade war with the U.S.
title: California lawmakers are begging Quebec's premier to put U.S. booze back on the shelves. She won't budge

description: Sotheby's says 67-million-year-old Tyrannosaurus rex fossil, which includes 'exceptionally preserved' skull containing a gaping jaw of powerful teeth, is now the most expensive set of dinosaur bones ever auctioned.
title: T. rex nicknamed Gus sells at auction for record $50 million US

description: A new professional soccer team is launching in Winnipeg, just a year after the last one folded. This time, it's a women's team. The question is whether it can survive where a men's team shut down after only seven years.
title: Winnipeg has a new pro soccer team. Can the women last longer than the men?

description: A former federal politician denies trafficking any firearms but acknowledges he illegally transferred three guns, after police seized hundreds of weapons from his western Manitoba home last week.
title: 'I broke the law,' former Manitoba MP Inky Mark says after police seize over 400 firearms

description: A photo posted on U.S. Sen. Mitch McConnell's Facebook page may have done little to convince the internet that he's still alive, but it's working as a punchline for late-night television hosts in the U.S.
title: Late-night TV hosts skewer Mitch McConnell's proof-of-life photo

description: A Montreal family is living in a trailer outside a duplex they bought while tenants are challenging the repossession request through Quebec’s housing tribunal.
title: Montreal duplex dispute leaves family living in a trailer on the driveway, tenants facing uncertainty

description: Following the closure of Dr. George Chan Dentistry in Brantford, Ont
title: A look inside Brantford, Ont., dental office flagged for sterilization lapses, leading to patient testing

description: Norway's star striker was photographed stepping off the team plane in Oslo Monday carrying a Dolce & Gabbana tote in one hand and a taxidermy raccoon in the other.
title: Yes, Erling Haaland brought home a taxidermy raccoon from his World Cup travels

description: Hudson Williams seems to have reached a breaking point when alleged autograph sellers followed him to his residence in Paris over the weekend. Multiple videos of the incident were shared online, garnering divided reactions on social media.
title: Hudson Williams confronts alleged autograph sellers in Paris
Sizzling temperatures and the threat of storms blanket much of the country in weather warnings

description: The federal government announced a handful of new consular appointments on Tuesday, shaking up the diplomatic team across the U.S. after trade talks stretched past the early July benchmark.
title: Carney government shakes up diplomatic missions in U.S. with new consular appointments

description: Twelve states, including California and New York, sued to block Paramount’s takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery on Monday, arguing that the $81-billion US merger would "extinguish competition" in Hollywood and lead to fewer choices for consumers across the U.S.
title: 12 states sue Paramount over Warner takeover, say merger would 'extinguish competition'

description: An Israeli strike and gunfire killed at least nine Palestinians, including a 10-year-old boy and a senior Hamas police officer, in the Gaza Strip on Tuesday, Gazan health and police officials said.
title: Boy, 10, among 9 Palestinians killed in Israeli strike, gunfire in Gaza: officials

description: The cost of a barrel of Brent crude, the international standard, was up around $86 US on Tuesday morning. That's higher than oil has been in recent weeks after the U.S. and Iran signed a memorandum of understanding to end the war, but below the $100 mark that oil has reached earlier in the war.
title: Oil rises to 4-week highs as conflict in Iran escalates

description: Ten questions are on the ballot this October, five of which concern immigration — something that has been overshadowed since the separation question was announced in May. CBC News sought to find out more about how Calgary’s multicultural communities feel about these proposals.
title: Immigration is on the ballot. Here’s what some of Alberta’s multicultural communities say about the referendum

description: The Northern Super League has announced that its seventh team in the women’s league will be situated in Winnipeg. The first expansion team in NSL history will kick off in the 2027 season but is preparing for pre-season that typically begins in February 2027.
title: Winnipeg expansion team, led by Desiree Scott, set to become NSL's 7th franchise

description: Police in southwestern Colorado say a man from British Columbia has died after the helicopter he was piloting crashed on Sunday.
title: B.C. helicopter pilot killed in Colorado crash while on wildfire duty
Death toll from Bangkok music bar fire rises to 30, dozens remain in hospital

description: A U.S. airbase in Jordan was targeted by Iranian ballistic missiles on Tuesday, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said, while calling on Jordanians to dismantle American bases in the kingdom.
title: Tehran retaliates across Mideast after U.S. restarts blockade

description: Berwick, N.S., is using solar, hydroelectric and wind power in effort to become a zero-emissions community.
title: This N.S. town wants to use 100% renewable energy. It’s more than halfway there

description: Joël Lapointe, stumbled upon what he thought looked like a suspicious pit in Quebec's Côte-Nord region while he was wandering with his Google Maps cursor in 2024. But it turned out to be a 390-million-year-old meteor crater — never before identified, until now.
title: Amateur astronomer saw a pit in Quebec on Google Maps. It turned out to be a 390-million-year-old meteor crater
Assembly of First Nations gathers for summer assembly amid concerns about water bill, major projects

description: Just three days after Prime Minister Mark Carney left Saudi Arabia, the Houthis of Yemen announced that their four-year-old ceasefire with the kingdom had ended. But even with Saudi Arabia potentially embroiled in two regional wars, it offers real opportunities for business and investment that the Carney government is determined to exploit.
title: Canada is making a bet on Saudi Arabia despite war and political risk
Canadian trips to U.S. inch up despite months-long travel boycott

description: A Canadian soldier killed during the First World War was recently buried in northern France after his remains were unearthed during a construction project.
title: Dozens of WWI remains were found at a French construction site — including a Canadian soldier

description: More than 18 months since Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya was detained without charge by Israeli authorities in Gaza, his family and human rights organizations say they fear that his deteriorating health condition and reported abuse could lead to the prominent doctor's death.
title: Family of Gaza hospital chief detained by Israel 'shocked' over his deteriorating health condition

description: Drug smuggling charges carrying a possible life sentence were thrown out of court after a Windsor judge says the cross-border truck driver's Charter rights were violated in an "egregious" manner.
title: Judge throws out $13M drug smuggling charges against trucker over 'egregious' Charter rights violations

description: Advocates say a province-wide educational assistant shortage is leaving high-needs students unsupported and forcing classroom evacuations, while the province highlights record funding.
title: Ontario education workers raise alarm about EA shortage ahead of contract deadline

description: Since a ferocious storm deluged Ottawa on Canada Day, flooding thousands of basements, some residents have discovered that their home insurance policies don't cover damage caused by groundwater.
title: Ottawa homeowner had 'enhanced' flood coverage, but insurer still denied her claim after Canada Day storm
